## Checklist
- [ ] `claude plugin validate .` passes (or CI does)
- [ ] All examples pass `check_article.py` with no blocking checks (or the PR explains why)
- [ ] For method changes: a before and after on at least one example
- [ ] For examples: quotes are verbatim and ≤ 25 words, read dates are given, and there are no invented first-hand claims
